insight.title: The Engineer Who Removed All Road Signs to Stop Accidents
insight.subtitle: How a radical experiment proved that more rules can create more danger.
insight.notificationHook: He removed traffic lights to stop accidents

sections.text: In 2001, Dutch traffic engineer Hans Monderman faced a dangerous, accident-prone intersection. Instead of adding more signs, barriers, and lights, he decided to do the exact opposite.
Monderman stripped the intersection of all traffic lights, road markings, and signs. He wanted drivers to stop looking at rules and start looking at each other.
Without instructions, drivers slowed down, made eye contact, and negotiated their way through. Accidents dropped to zero, and traffic flowed faster than ever before.
Clear instructions often replace clear thinking.
